design: The pipeline from the outcome definition to the verdicts (45 boosted fits, five gates, evidence score S, routing) re-run under alternative outcome definitions, all on the CPU, with features, model settings, seeds and campus splits of the stored fits. V0 passes the study's definition through the same code and is the reference for V1 to V3; it is also compared with the stored verdicts, which come from GPU fits. A pair without a verdict under one definition counts as not supported in agreement statistics, as in the routing.

V0.name: study definition
V0.definition: reactive labour hours in quarter t+1 above the system-specific 75th percentile of positive next-quarter reactive labour, fitted on the training campuses of each model

V1.name: work-order count
V1.definition: number of reactive work orders in quarter t+1 above the system-specific 75th percentile of positive next-quarter counts, fitted on the training campuses of each model

V2.name: per-campus labour threshold
V2.definition: reactive labour hours in quarter t+1 above the 75th percentile of positive next-quarter reactive labour of the same campus and system; in the held-out check the target campus is labelled with the peer-pooled threshold of V0

V3.name: occurrence
V3.definition: at least one reactive work order in quarter t+1

system_groups.definition: stable: supported in all nine held-out maps of the stored pipeline; provisional: the four systems supported in some held-out maps

fit_configuration.note: scale_pos_weight is set at fit time from the label counts (n_negative / n_positive) and so follows the outcome definition
